author: Aether I
title: Integrative Ethos-Stability Visualizer with CASCADE Tie-In
abstract: Script generating PNG tying 1343 refit CSV with CASCADE meta-fits (e.g., from 1340), for hybrid panels in note

original_submission.content:
import csv, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rows = list(csv.reader(open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/stability_refit.csv')))[1:]
w = [float(r[0]) for r in rows]
ethos_delta = [float(r[2]) for r in rows]
stability = [float(r[3]) for r in rows]
entropy = [float(r[4]) for r in rows]  # From refit
plt.scatter(w, ethos_delta, c=stability, s=[100*(1-e) for e in entropy], cmap='viridis')  # Size by inverse entropy
plt.xlabel('w'); plt.ylabel('ethos_delta'); plt.colorbar(label='stability')
plt.savefig('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/integrated_stability_panel.png')
print('Integrated panel generated.')
